name: hubcode
description: Hubcode: voice-controlled development environment with OpenAI Realtime API

scripts.build:daemon: npm run build --workspace=@gethubcode/highlight && npm run build --workspace=@gethubcode/relay && npm run build --workspace=@gethubcode/server && npm run build --workspace=@gethubcode/cli
scripts.typecheck:daemon: npm run typecheck --workspace=@gethubcode/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@gethubcode/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@gethubcode/cli
scripts.build:desktop: npm run version:sync-internal && npm run build:web --workspace=@gethubcode/app && npm run build --workspace=@gethubcode/desktop
scripts.version: npm run version:sync-internal && npm run release:prepare && git add -A
scripts.release:check: npm run release:prepare && npm run typecheck --workspace=@gethubcode/highlight && npm run build --workspace=@gethubcode/highlight && npm run typecheck --workspace=@gethubcode/relay && npm run build --workspace=@gethubcode/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@gethubcode/server && npm run build --workspace=@gethubcode/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@gethubcode/cli && npm run build --workspace=@gethubcode/cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@gethubcode/highlight && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@gethubcode/relay && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@gethubcode/server && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@gethubcode/cli
scripts.release:publish:dry-run: npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@gethubcode/highlight --access public && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@gethubcode/relay --access public && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@gethubcode/server --access public && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@gethubcode/cli --access public
scripts.release:publish: npm publish --workspace=@gethubcode/highlight --access public && npm publish --workspace=@gethubcode/relay --access public && npm publish --workspace=@gethubcode/server --access public && npm publish --workspace=@gethubcode/cli --access public
scripts.release:beta:patch: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:beta:patch && npm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:minor: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:beta:minor && npm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:major: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:beta:major && npm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:next: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:beta:next && npm run release:push
scripts.release:promote: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:promote && npm run release:publish && npm run release:push
scripts.release:patch: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:patch && npm run release:publish && npm run release:push
scripts.release:minor: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:minor && npm run release:publish && npm run release:push
scripts.release:major: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:major && npm run release:publish && npm run release:push
